description: Generate a secure checkout link the user opens to add cash to their own balance (the money that funds new cards) via Apple Pay or Google Pay, in USD. Calling this tool moves NO money and initiates NO transfer: it only prepares a single-use hosted payment page — the exact equivalent of the user clicking 'Add funds' in the dashboard. The user personally reviews, authorizes, and completes (or abandons) the payment in their own browser with their own payment method; you never see or handle payment credentials. If a one-time phone verification is needed first, this tool automatically sends the user a code and tells you where it went: ask the user for the code, call verify_phone with it, then call add_funds again.

amount_cents.description: Amount to add in cents (e.g. 5000 = $50.00). Typical range: $20.00 to $10,000.00 (2000 to 1000000 cents); the exact range depends on the active funding provider and is returned by the API when the amount is invalid.

payment_method.description: Payment method for the checkout: apple_pay or google_pay. Ask the user which one their device has; apple_pay only when unknown.

name: add_funds

amountUsd.description: Amount of the created checkout in USD.

checkoutUrl.description: Single-use payment link to hand the user verbatim (present when a checkout was created).
